Title: 'Jemon Shuniachi Part 3 Ed. 1st' (1959, Sri Sri Ramkrishna Ashram, Howrah, 315 pages, 18.3 MB PDF, barcode 07019990362395). Author Swami Sambuddhananda (1891–1974) was a direct disciple of Holy Mother Sri Sarada Devi and disciple of Swami Abhedananda. Work covers reminiscences of Swami Abhedananda and early days of Ramakrishna movement. Under Indian Copyright Act 1957 Section 22, copyright subsists for 60 years post-mortem (until 2035). Furthermore, this scan is Part 3 only; Parts 1 and 2 are missing. Unpermitted scan under copyright, not an authorized complete free reader.
